reseal.title: Reseal the audit chain
reseal.desc: Establishes a new verified baseline from this point forward. It does not repair or erase history — existing entries and any broken link stay exactly as they are, and the reseal itself is recorded in the log.

card.title: Audit trail
card.desc: A chronological record of every action on the system: user, action, entity and time.

noaccess.title: You do not have access to the audit log
noaccess.hint: Contact your system administrator to be granted Audit.View

hide.title: Hide from view (the entry is retained for audit)
hide.confirm: Hide this entry from the view? It stays stored for audit and the chain integrity is unaffected.

hideAll.title: Hide all entries from view
hideAll.desc: Hides every entry from this view. Nothing is deleted — the rows are retained, the hash chain stays intact and still verifies, and this action is itself recorded as the next entry.

cert.title: Certificate of Document Destruction
cert.attestation: This document certifies that the records listed above were permanently destroyed after their statutory retention period elapsed, under a two-stage approval cycle (verification followed by final approval).

att.title: Attendance
att.confirmClose: Close attendance for {{month}}? Its exceptions cannot change afterwards.
att.importHint: One line per punch: employee number, Palestine date-time (2026-10-05 08:30), optional device code. The automatic device connector waits for the device type decision.

resolutionHint.Justified: Mission or approved departure: no deduction
resolutionHint.DeductLeave: One day from the leave type set in settings
resolutionHint.DeductSalary: Minutes reach payroll the same month

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.confirmPublish: Publish the roster and notify employees?
shifts.pickSiteHint: Pick a site and month to see the roster.
shifts.noStaff: No employees work at this site.
shifts.coverageHint: The coverage row turns red below the minimum. Minimums come from the Authority; 0 = none.

pay.title: Payroll month
pay.illustrative: Every rate and amount is a setting entered by the payroll officer. Nothing is hard-coded until the Authority approves the rules.
pay.inputsHint: Manual inputs for per-unit elements (overtime…). Night shifts and absence are read from rosters and attendance.
pay.disbursementHint: Entitlement is calculated in full; the decision sets what is paid. The rest accumulates for the employee.
pay.confirmDisburse: Approve the disbursement decision? Entitlement movements are booked and never edited.

paySet.title: Pay elements & scale
paySet.datedHint: Rates are added with an effective date and never edited: a correction is a newer row, so past months recalculate the same.
paySet.scaleHint: Basic salary per grade from a date. Contract staff get their own amount from Employee amounts.
paySet.taxHint: A full table from a date; brackets must be contiguous. The newest table applies to months after it.
paySet.employeeHint: A contract salary or fixed allowance for one employee, with dates. Takes precedence over the scale and general rate.

leaveSet.hint: Each type with its path, entitlement and carry-over cap. Values come from the Authority and are entered here once approved.

cal.hint: Weekend days, the default hours for staff without a roster, and the leave type absences are deducted from.
